label: Every being contingent at w has some reason for its existence
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the local existence PSR for contingents. At the selected world w, every being that exists at w and is absent at some accessible world (MODAL_CONTINGENCY_1) has some #312 reason token explaining its existence fact at w. It is the contingent-only, single-world weakening of STMT-NO-BRUTE-EXISTENCE-AT (which also covers necessary existents); the restriction is a law of the B2 controls. No strengthens relation is registered: a new argument with STMT-NO-BRUTE-EXISTENCE-AT as premise fails the sense check, because that statement links both senses of BRUTE_EXISTENCE_FACT_VERSUS_GROUNDING_BRUTE (a pre-existing record, left unchanged). It says nothing about the kind of reason: a reason token need not be a cause, concrete, adequate or noncircular.
